One card had one line the other had multiple lines. They were then asked which line on the second card was the same length as the line on the first card. In this study about a half dozen people would be tested at a time - all stating their answers publicly. The catch is that all but one of them were in on the experiment and the plants would intentionally give the same, and wrong, answer.
